snippet.title: Love is All Around Collection Trailer | Love is All Around 1 & Love is All Around 2
snippet.description:
The Love Is All Around Collection brings together both the first and second installments of the game on a single disc. Coming out on PlayStation 5 on 24th December 2025, it offers fans the complete experience in one package.

Love Is All Around 1: an interactive, full-motion video experience that simulates a heartfelt love story in a real-life setting. You will not only meet but also fall in love with six beauties with completely different personalities and styles, eventually embark on an immersive and sweet journey one after another.

Love Is All Around 2: featuring cast members of the original game in a historical drama setting, this sequel set in ancient China delivers an audiovisual feast that guarantees you an immersive experience with heartfelt emotional resonance, sweet romantic thrills, and a carefully woven plot of intrigue and suspense. Every choice you make carries consequences, leading to completely different story branches and endings as you navigate both love and hidden dangers.
